name: Synic Solution Co Ltd
summary: Established in 2005 and based in Seongnam-si, South Korea, Synic Solution Co., Ltd. offers a broad spectrum of semiconductor design and manufacturing services for its international fabless customers. Their core offerings include custom ASIC and analog design, production, and dedicated technical assistance. The company operates advanced foundries supporting diverse technologies such as CMOS, GaN and SiC, MEMS, and silicon photonics. Additionally, Synic Solution develops specialized payment systems, including the SKY7000 multi-payment support board, which seamlessly integrates its SKY5000/5100 Smart Card Reader IC and SKY3700B Magnetic Stripe Reader with a Renesas CPU. Other key components in their payment portfolio are the SKY3700B, engineered for decoding magnetic stripe data, and the SKY5000, an IC card reader microcontroller chip. Furthermore, Synic Solution provides System-on-Chip (SoC) platforms tailored for various applications, including Internet of Things (IoT) devices, payment systems, and sensor technologies.
